title: "DuckVEP and vep-rs on HG002"
output:
  github_document:
    html_preview: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.path = "figures/veprs-", fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5.5,
  dpi = 144, dev = "ragg_png", dev.args = list(background = "white"),
  fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
root <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("DUCKVEP_REPO_ROOT", getwd()), mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "readme-evidence.R"))
data_dir <- newest_dir(file.path(root, "benchmarks", "data", "vep_rs"), "_paired$", "timings.tsv")
rel <- function(file) file.path("data", "vep_rs", basename(data_dir), file)
timings <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "timings.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stages <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "stage_timings.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
receipt <- read.delim(file.path(data_dir, "run_receipt.tsv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
receipt <- setNames(receipt$value, receipt$key)
adjudication <- file.path(data_dir, "adjudication.txt")
rows <- read_box(adjudication, "duckvep_rows")
tuples <- read_box(adjudication, "duckvep_tuples")
verdicts <- read_box(adjudication, "verdict")
replay <- read_box(adjudication, "vep_tuples")
paired <- subset(timings, kind == "benchmark" & threads == 1L)
paired <- paired[order(paired$tool, paired$run), ]
stopifnot(nrow(paired) >= 2L, all(table(paired$tool) == table(paired$tool)[[1L]]))
runs <- max(paired$run)
cpu <- receipt[["cpu_affinity"]]
med <- function(tool, column) median(paired[[column]][paired$tool == tool])
cpu_s <- function(tool) median((paired$user_s + paired$sys_s)[paired$tool == tool])
n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
pct <- function(x, y) sprintf("%.3f%%", 100 * x / y)
verdict_n <- function(label) sum(verdicts$n[verdicts$verdict == label])
library(ggplot2)
```

One sites-only HG002 v4.2.1 GRCh38 genome, split to one ALT allele per record, annotated with Ensembl `r sub("_.*", "", basename(receipt[["vep_rs_cache"]]))` transcripts by both tools. DuckVEP writes its rich typed relation to Parquet; vep-rs writes VEP tab text. The tools are compared as `(allele, transcript, sorted consequence terms)` on the transcripts both emit, and executable Ensembl VEP adjudicates every tuple where they differ.

| | DuckVEP | vep-rs |
|---|---:|---:|
| Median wall time, one core | `r sprintf("%.1f s", med("duckvep", "wall_s"))` | `r sprintf("%.1f s", med("vep-rs", "wall_s"))` |
| Median CPU time | `r sprintf("%.1f s", cpu_s("duckvep"))` | `r sprintf("%.1f s", cpu_s("vep-rs"))` |
| Median peak memory | `r sprintf("%.2f GiB", med("duckvep", "maxrss_kib") / 1048576)` | `r sprintf("%.2f GiB", med("vep-rs", "maxrss_kib") / 1048576)` |
| Output rows | `r n(rows$duckvep_rows)` | `r n(rows$veprs_rows)` |
| Transcripts in output | `r n(rows$duckvep_transcripts)` | `r n(rows$veprs_transcripts)` |
| Tuples on shared transcripts | `r n(tuples$duckvep_tuples)` | `r n(tuples$veprs_tuples)` |
| Differing tuples where VEP sides with the tool | `r n(verdict_n("VEP agrees with DuckVEP"))` | `r n(verdict_n("VEP agrees with vep-rs"))` |

`r n(tuples$matching)` of `r n(tuples$duckvep_tuples)` tuples agree (`r pct(tuples$matching, tuples$duckvep_tuples)`). Of the `r n(tuples$only_duckvep)` that differ, VEP agrees with DuckVEP on `r n(verdict_n("VEP agrees with DuckVEP"))`, with vep-rs on `r n(verdict_n("VEP agrees with vep-rs"))`, and with neither on `r n(verdict_n("VEP differs from both"))`.

## Paired single-core timings

The `r runs` cold-process pairs ran one after another on CPU `r cpu`, vep-rs first in each pair. Each timed process includes startup, extension load, model snapshot restore, VCF read and sort, annotation, and output.

```{r paired-wall, fig.height=3.6, fig.cap="Bars are medians; dots are the individual processes. Outputs were disk-backed."}
wall <- paired[c("run", "tool", "wall_s")]
wall$tool <- factor(wall$tool, levels = c("duckvep", "vep-rs"), labels = c("DuckVEP", "vep-rs"))
medians <- aggregate(wall_s ~ tool, wall, median)
medians$label_x <- aggregate(wall_s ~ tool, wall, max)$wall_s
ggplot(wall, aes(wall_s, tool, fill = tool)) +
  geom_col(data = medians, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(color = tool), size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(data = medians, aes(x = label_x, label = sprintf("median %.1f s", wall_s)), hjust = -0.15,
    size = 4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(DuckVEP = "#087E8B", `vep-rs` = "#6B7280")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(DuckVEP = "#087E8B", `vep-rs` = "#6B7280")) +
  scale_x_continuous("Wall time (seconds)", limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(y = NULL, title = "Whole genome on one core",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d process pairs pinned to CPU %s", runs, cpu)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Where the time goes in DuckVEP

A separate probe after the pairs times five complete queries on the restored model. Extension setup and restore are outside these timers, and the queries are alternatives, not additive steps.

```{r query-stages, fig.height=5.2, fig.cap="Each point is one separately timed query."}
stage_labels <- c(compact_count = "Compact relation, counted",
  rich_count = "Rich relation, counted", rich_touch = "Rich relation, every column read",
  rich_joined_parquet = "Rich relation, identifiers joined, Parquet",
  compact_parquet = "Compact relation, Parquet")
stage_plot <- stages
stage_plot$output <- ifelse(grepl("^compact", stage_plot$stage), "Compact", "Rich")
stage_plot$variant <- factor(stage_labels[stage_plot$stage], levels = rev(unname(stage_labels)))
ggplot(stage_plot, aes(seconds, variant, color = output)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = seconds, yend = variant), color = "#B8C0CC", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f s", seconds)), hjust = -0.2, size = 4.2) +
  scale_x_continuous("Query time (seconds)", limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Compact = "#0072B2", Rich = "#009E73")) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(title = "DuckVEP query timings, one core", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

## Agreement

```{r adjudicated-differences, fig.height=4.2, fig.cap="VEP verdicts on the differing tuples. The count axis is logarithmic."}
verdict <- verdicts
verdict$side <- ifelse(grepl("DuckVEP", verdict$verdict), "DuckVEP",
  ifelse(grepl("vep-rs", verdict$verdict), "vep-rs", "Neither"))
verdict$verdict <- factor(verdict$verdict, levels = rev(verdict$verdict))
ggplot(verdict, aes(n, verdict, color = side)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text(aes(x = n * 1.6, label = n(n)), hjust = 0, size = 4.2) +
  scale_x_log10("Differing tuples (log scale)", labels = n,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.3))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(DuckVEP = "#087E8B", `vep-rs` = "#6B7280", Neither = "#9F1239")) +
  labs(title = "VEP adjudication of tuple differences", y = NULL) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

On the sites where the tools differ, VEP emits `r n(replay$vep_tuples)` tuples. DuckVEP matches `r n(replay$duckvep_matches)` and vep-rs matches `r n(replay$veprs_matches)`. VEP has `r n(replay$vep_rows_absent_from_duckvep)` rows on transcripts DuckVEP's database-built model does not hold and `r n(replay$vep_rows_absent_from_veprs)` rows vep-rs does not emit. DuckVEP emits `r n(replay$duckvep_rows_absent_from_vep)` rows absent from VEP and vep-rs emits `r n(replay$veprs_rows_absent_from_vep)`.

DuckVEP emits `r n(rows$duckvep_transcripts - rows$shared_transcripts)` transcripts that vep-rs does not, because its model is built from the Ensembl core database while the vep-rs cache is built from the GTF by `vep-cache-builder`. Agreement is measured only on the `r n(rows$shared_transcripts)` transcripts both emit, and tuples on which the tools agree were not replayed through VEP.

```{r residuals, include=FALSE}
# The witnesses below describe exactly two tuples on which VEP does not side with DuckVEP.
stopifnot(tuples$only_duckvep - verdict_n("VEP agrees with DuckVEP") == 2L)
```

The two tuples where VEP does not side with DuckVEP have [two-record witnesses](../test/duckvep/conformance/veprs_residual_witness.vcf):

- **`e284879` on `ENST00000696609`.** A deletion across the UTR and start codon leaves an upstream `ATG` before the original CDS suffix. DuckVEP emits `start_lost` and `start_retained_variant`; VEP and vep-rs emit only `start_lost`.
- **`e391762` on `ENST00001011173`.** Deleting the middle base of a terminal `TGA` leaves `TA`, and the next base makes `TAG`. DuckVEP calls the stop retained, VEP calls it lost, and vep-rs adds a frameshift term.

[Diagnostic SQL](../test/duckvep/conformance/veprs_residual_witness.sql) reproduces DuckVEP's rows from the runner's snapshot and mappings; load the extension and set the SQL variable `comparison_dir` first. Direct VEP reruns reproduce both oracle rows.

<details>
<summary>Run design and reproduction</summary>

Render from the repository root with `Rscript benchmarks/scripts/render_benchmarks.R vep_rs`. The report reads the newest `benchmarks/data/vep_rs/*_paired` directory, here `r basename(data_dir)`, measured at DuckVEP revision `r substr(receipt[["source_revision"]], 1, 7)`.

vep-rs ran its release binary with `--fork 1`. DuckVEP ran with `SET threads = 1`, so both used one worker on the pinned core. The adjudicating VEP uses `--gtf` with the same GTF the vep-rs cache was built from. [`run_receipt.tsv`](`r rel("run_receipt.tsv")`) records the executables and their hashes; [`preparation.receipt.tsv`](`r rel("preparation.receipt.tsv")`) and [`preparation_outputs.sha256`](`r rel("preparation_outputs.sha256")`) bind the inputs and the prepared snapshot. Paths in them locate the measurement host's files. [`timings.tsv`](`r rel("timings.tsv")`), [`stage_timings.tsv`](`r rel("stage_timings.tsv")`) and [`adjudication.txt`](`r rel("adjudication.txt")`) are the raw outputs this page is drawn from.

To reproduce, set `DUCKVEP_READER_EXT`, `DUCKVEP_MODEL`, `VEP_RS_CACHE`, `VEP_GTF`, `VEP_FASTA` and `VEP_RS_DIR` as described in the header of [`benchmark_duckvep_vep_rs.sh`](benchmark_duckvep_vep_rs.sh), set `BENCH_OUT` to the output filesystem, and run:

```bash
benchmark_duckvep_vep_rs.sh --vcf INPUT.vcf.gz --work WORKDIR --threads 1 --runs 3 --cpu-affinity CPU \
  | tee adjudication.txt
```

`VEP_RS_CACHE` is the species and release directory that contains `transcripts/`. The runner rejects a vep-rs run that exits cleanly without annotation rows. Preparation is reused only when its inputs and generated files match their recorded hashes.

HGVS, regulatory features and plugins are outside this comparison.

</details>
